title: Drone Lab vision film
provenance: Chapter data transcribed from earlier browser inspection in the project conversation; original JSON, MP4 and caption bytes were not recovered.
disclaimer: Planned product experience. Visuals and example records are illustrative; no working simulator or measured outcomes are claimed.

chapters.title: The product vision
chapters.text: A virtual flight laboratory for building and understanding autonomous systems. Build. Observe. Compare. Improve. This is the intended product experience.

chapters.title: Autonomous flight
chapters.text: Start a known mission. The virtual drone flies without operator steering. The mission judge awards five gates in order, using the same flight rules. A valid landing completes the mission. Preserve the run for independent review.

chapters.title: Replay and explain
chapters.text: Scrub the saved flight and jump to the exact event that changed its outcome. Inspect the course, controller, trajectory and judge events together.

chapters.title: Compare fairly
chapters.text: Compare controllers on identical inputs. Completion comes before speed. Show failed runs and their reasons. Keep the original baseline reproducible.

chapters.title: Test robustness
chapters.text: Expand to seeded courses and isolated disturbances with a locked protocol. Report every attempt and paired outcome. Separate development from evaluation.

chapters.title: Explore research branches
chapters.text: After the benchmark, choose learned control, two-drone missions or bounded AI experiments. Each research branch earns its own evidence. Hardware remains an optional feasibility decision.

chapters.title: Connect vision to release evidence
chapters.text: Connect the vision, specifications, stories and acceptance criteria to delivery evidence. Link code, verification, acceptance and shipped versions. Publish release notes from that record.
